sql_query.query: SELECT ct.id, ct.user_id, u.name, ct.cycle, ct.amount, ct.status, ct.confirmed_by, ct.created_at FROM _contributions ct JOIN _users u ON u.id = ct.user_id WHERE ct.circle_id = $1 AND ct.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _memberships m WHERE m.circle_id = $1 AND m.user_id = $2) ORDER BY ct.cycle DESC, ct.created_at DESC
